crossRefs.note: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak…
When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf…
When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.
In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
